newsitem.title: UK: BBC regains edge over UK commercial radio.
newsitem.headline: BBC regains edge over UK commercial radio.

text.p: The BBC has regained its edge over commercial radio in Britain, nosing ahead by 0.1 percentage points, the Radio Advertising Bureau said on Monday.

BBC Radio, which includes the five BBC radio stations, accounted for a 48.9 percent share of all listening hours in the third quarter, versus 48.8 percent for commercial radio, the advertising bureau said.
"However, looking at the longer term to smooth quarterly fluctuations, we see commercial radio offering the advertiser a large reach and more total hours of listening," the advertising bureau said.
